item: P2-115 (board F39#12) Tidewake forward-camp creature bed
made_by: Visual lane (Claude), 3 Nov 2026, Blender 4.2.3 LTS, procedural build; no Meshy, no external assets
reference: Drafted reference (text): a creature nest bed for a seaside camp. A thick woven sea-grass rim (about 0.8 m crest, about 4.6 m across, readable edge-on), driftwood branches lashed around it, a domed sailcloth cushion inside, a sea-teal wool blanket with one pale woven stripe draped over the cushion and the rim, loose straw spilling out. Palette: straw gold, driftwood grey-brown, cream canvas, teal. No red or oxblood. Answers the GPU WD2 judges' path for P2-115: 'a raised nest or cushion shape with bedding'.
scale_check: source/scale_check.jpg: the nest beside a 1.80 m cylinder (the trainer). Rim crest 0.82 m (below the trainer's hip), 4.6 m span, so creatures taller than the trainer fit inside, the same span as the Meshy 31 Oct bed it replaces when the flag is on.
textures: Baked from procedural Cycles materials into packed 1024/2048 albedo images
